stories.title: Chinese neuroscientist at Princeton is held by ICE after detention at Washington airport
stories.summary: A Chinese neuroscience researcher at Princeton University is in the custody of immigration authorities after she was detained while trying to get on a flight back from Washington, marking another instance of federal enforcement at airports.

stories.title: Judge orders former Utah lawmaker to appear in court again in February on fraud charges
stories.summary: Criminal proceedings against a former Utah lawmaker moved to the next stage Monday as Trevor Lee appeared before the judge overseeing his case.

stories.title: The surprising connection between church attendance and online gambling
stories.summary: The 2026 American Family Survey revealed a link between attending church and betting, with younger adults reporting the most frequent use of gambling apps and websites.

stories.title: Storms to hit both coasts, threatening Thanksgiving travel for millions and Macy's 100th parade
stories.summary: Mother Nature could crash Thanksgiving this year by bringing storms on the East and West coasts that will amplify king tide woes as they look to snarl travel and holiday plans.

stories.title: Salt Lake Temple rededication date announced in letter from the First Presidency
stories.summary: The Salt Lake Temple will be rededicated on Dec. 5, 2027, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints announced on Monday in a letter that said the remodel is finished.

stories.title: Driver going over 120 mph with no headlights on freeway is arrested
stories.summary: A man was arrested over the weekend and accused of twice fleeing from police in Utah County while going over 100 mph.

stories.title: States sue Musk companies over flood of sexualized images made with AI chatbot Grok
stories.summary: Two Democratic attorneys general are suing several of Elon Musk's companies in connection with the controversy over his AI chatbot's ability to create sexualized images.

stories.title: 12,000 evacuated from Don Toliver concert after an unknown substance sickens fans
stories.summary: More than 12,000 fans were evacuated from a concert by American rapper Don Toliver and over 80 were treated by medics after an unknown irritant was released in the crowd, authorities in the English city of Manchester said Monday.

stories.title: Utah Community Credit Union strike $7M partnership with Southern Utah University
stories.summary: Southern Utah University plans to build an on-campus Utah Community Credit Union branch, build a football operations facility and erect a digital billboard on I-15 through a $7 million partnership with the credit union.

stories.title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as its president and CEO on Monday in a surprise move shortly after rejecting his offer to return.

stories.title: A pool company took Utahns for millions. The response destroyed their faith in the legal system
stories.summary: Multiple people have filed lawsuits claiming they were wronged by Emerald Pools & Spas, but the company filed for bankruptcy, and many of them say they have not gotten any help.

stories.title: Appeals court says federal law requiring accommodations for pregnant workers is unconstitutional
stories.summary: An appeals court has struck down a federal law that requires workplaces to provide accommodations for pregnant women, saying Congress violated the U.S. Constitution when it passed the law in 2022.
